title: Layering check
summary: An include the build's layering check rejects shows no error
prose: Bazel's `layering_check`, and any build that has Clang check the uses its module maps declare (`-fmodules-decluse`), rejects an include of a header that no dependency of the target provides. clice compiles a file as if no module map named it: such an include compiles clean in the editor, and only the build reports it.

value.wrong: the build rejects the include of a module the target does not depend on
